_what: THE THIRD-PARTY FLOOR: every sibling-server read tool allowlisted in third-party-reads.txt that no prompt exercises, each with its reason. Same contract as unprompted-baseline.json (may only SHRINK; every entry needs a reason), enforced by verify-coverage.mjs check 3.

reasons.mcp__commerce-extensibility__aio-where: reports aio CLI context; our tools replaced the select dance, so a producer ask for it would itself be a routing failure — kept allowlisted for diagnosis only
reasons.mcp__dropins__analyze_project: diagnostic over a storefront checkout tree; meaningful only mid-task inside a dropin work session, no standalone producer ask
reasons.mcp__dropins__check_block_health: diagnostic over a specific block; presupposes a block in a failing state
reasons.mcp__dropins__check_config: config diagnostic; presupposes a dropin debugging session in flight
reasons.mcp__dropins__explain_event_flow: same knowledge family; routing measured by cross-graphql-shapes
reasons.mcp__dropins__get_upgrade_diff: meaningful only during a dropin version upgrade; no unattended fixture exists
reasons.mcp__dropins__list_containers: same family as list_events — one routing prompt per knowledge FAMILY, not per sibling tool
reasons.mcp__dropins__list_events: dropin knowledge reached via aem-researcher/aem-dropin-developer mid-task; routing pattern measured by cross-graphql-shapes
reasons.mcp__dropins__search_docs: docs search; cross-starter-kit-docs measures the docs-routing pattern for siblings
reasons.mcp__dropins__suggest_event_handler: generative suggestion tool; same as suggest_slot_implementation
reasons.mcp__dropins__suggest_slot_implementatio: generative suggestion tool; only sensible mid-implementation with a chosen slot
